name: XGrammar
author: mlc-ai
one_liner: Fast constrained-decoding engine that keeps LLM output inside a JSON schema, regex or context-free grammar.

loop.proposes: the next token from an inference engine such as vLLM or SGLang
loop.judged_by: a compiled grammar matcher that checks which tokens keep the output grammatical
loop.steers: invalid tokens are masked out before sampling, so the output always follows the grammar

not_proved: It guarantees structural correctness only, not that the content is accurate. A grammar that is too loose still lets nonsense through.
